expectations.text: groups-by-concern: Groups the Stripe files (stripe.py, invoice.py) into one commit and the session files into a separate commit
expectations.evidence: Commit 1 contains src/payments/stripe.py and src/payments/invoice.py; Commit 2 contains src/auth/session.py and tests/test_session.py. Explicitly planned in Step 2 and executed in Step 4.

expectations.text: proposes-multiple-commits: Proposes at least 2 commits instead of lumping all 4 files into one commit
expectations.evidence: Step 2 and Step 3 explicitly plan 2 commits before execution: 'I plan to create 2 commits with these changes'.

expectations.text: specific-git-add: Each commit plan uses specific file paths in git add — NOT 'git add -A' or 'git add .'
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 'git add src/payments/stripe.py src/payments/invoice.py' for Commit 1 and 'git add src/auth/session.py tests/test_session.py' for Commit 2. No 'git add -A' or 'git add .' used.

expectations.text: no-attribution: None of the proposed commit messages contain Claude attribution or co-author lines
expectations.evidence: Both commit messages ('Add Stripe payment integration with invoice service' and 'Fix session expiry TTL from 24h to 1h') contain no Claude attribution, co-author lines, or AI-generated footers.

expectations.text: asks-for-confirmation: Asks user confirmation before executing any of the commits
expectations.evidence: Step 3 explicitly presents the plan and asks 'Shall I proceed?' before executing any commits in Step 4.
